skillset.skill: 12s CT - 2200% Dark DMG (PHY). During Magia Drive: For 8s, reduce Enemies' Break RES by 30% + Increase own Arts by 20 & Skill's Break Power by 1000.

passive.ability2: Increase Arts by 100 when entering Magia Drive. When a Boss is Broken during Magia Drive, increase own Arts by 100.
